# duration-string: field, value, smallest unit, rounding mode, expected string
# zoned-until / zoned-since: start, end, smallest unit, rounding mode, expected duration
# epoch-milliseconds: epoch nanoseconds, expected epoch milliseconds (floor)

# zoned-next-transition: start, expected next transition epoch nanoseconds
# zoned-from-local: local date-time, time zone, expected zoned string
